invitation_only.body: Only people with an invitation code can sign up.

sales_assisted.name: Sales-assisted
sales_assisted.body: Organisations contact the platform team, who set them up.

developer.name: Full Developer ERP
developer.description: CRM to handover, finance, construction, HR and resident services for property developers.

community.name: Community / Building
community.description: Maintenance-only societies: flats, owners and payers, monthly dues, collections and services. No sales CRM.

portfolio.name: Portfolio Manager
portfolio.description: Several sites, each with its own association, books and bank, run by one management company.

custom.name: Custom modular
custom.description: Start from core and choose any modules that pass the dependency check.

core.name: Core
core.description: Identity, roles, people, sites and units, documents, approvals, notifications, audit, help and tours.

crm.name: Sales CRM
crm.description: Leads, opportunities, site visits and follow-ups.

projects.name: Projects
projects.description: Development projects on sites, phases and analytics.

inventory.name: Sales inventory
inventory.description: Unit matrix, price versions and holds.

sales.name: Sales and bookings
sales.description: Quotes, reservations, bookings, buyers, payment plans and transfers.

construction.name: Construction
construction.description: Milestones, site updates and customer publication.

receivables.name: Receivables
receivables.description: Billing accounts, invoices, proof verification, receipts, statements and collections.

dues.name: Community dues
dues.description: Charges, rate versions, overrides and monthly billing runs.

residents.name: Residents
residents.description: Ownership, occupancy, households and the resident roster.

resident_portal.name: Resident portal
resident_portal.description: The app for owners and residents.

online_payments.name: Online payments
online_payments.description: Merchant connections, payment intents and gateway webhooks.

banking.name: Banking
banking.description: Bank accounts, verified payees, bank feeds and reconciliation.

accounting.name: Accounting
accounting.description: Chart of accounts, periods, journals and statements.

payables.name: Payables
payables.description: Suppliers, bills, supplier payments and expenses.

procurement.name: Procurement
procurement.description: Purchase requests, quotations, orders and receipts.

payroll.name: Payroll
payroll.description: Payroll runs, disbursement status and posting.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Requests, work orders, technicians, SLAs and building assets.

parking.name: Parking
parking.description: Spaces, allocations, vehicles and guest parking.

communications.name: Communications
communications.description: Notices, messages, templates and delivery status.

reports.name: Reports
reports.description: The report centre; each report needs its source module.

public_website.name: Public website
public_website.description: Luxury project sites; enquiries become leads.

white_label.name: White label
white_label.description: Custom domain and branded theme, within accessibility guardrails.

FREE.name: Free plan
FREE.description: A zero-price plan; limits and history are still recorded.

TRIAL.name: Free trial
TRIAL.description: No charges until the trial ends.

ONE_TIME.name: One-time fee
ONE_TIME.description: Charged once, on the first invoice.

FIXED_RECURRING.name: Base platform fee
FIXED_RECURRING.description: A fixed price every billing period.

PER_MODULE.name: Module add-on
PER_MODULE.description: A priced module; per site when the module is site-scoped.

TIERED.name: Tiered per flat
TIERED.description: Bands of flats at different prices.

USAGE.name: Usage
USAGE.description: Billed in arrears for use above the allowance.

dimensionHelp.gateway_authorized_events: Authorised online payments processed for the tenant.
dimensionHelp.api_calls: Calls made with the tenant's API keys.

errors.activate: The tenant could not be activated. Nothing was created.

type.title: What kind of organisation is this?
type.intro: The edition pre-selects modules and prices. You can change both in the next steps; access always follows the modules you grant.
type.label: Edition
type.presetNote: An edition is a starting point, not a limit (D-2).

org.intro: Who the tenant is and who to contact. Use fictional details in this demo.
org.displayNameHint: Shown in the app, for example Al-Noor Residency (Demo)
org.fictional: This prototype holds fictional data only. Nothing is sent to these contacts.

errors.contactPhone: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number.

sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: The places this tenant manages. Flat counts are declared estimates until the tenant imports its flats.
sites.name: Site name
sites.unitsHint: Declared estimate; usage snapshots replace it after go-live

errors.name: Site {{n}}: enter a name.
errors.units: Site {{n}}: enter the number of flats or units.

modules.title: Modules and site entitlements
modules.intro: The edition's modules are switched on. Add or remove modules; every requirement is checked as you go.
modules.showOthers_one: Show {{count}} more module not usual for this edition
modules.showOthers_other: Show {{count}} more modules not usual for this edition
modules.hideOthers: Hide modules not usual for this edition

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Start from the edition's rate card. Change any price, add components or schedule a price change. Every change is re-priced on the server.
pricing.trialHint: Charges, including onboarding, start when the trial ends.

errors.reason: Give a reason for every price that differs from the rate card.

counts.title: Usage and unit counts
counts.intro: How many of each thing the contract charges for. Before go-live these are declared estimates.
counts.estimateBody: Once the tenant imports its flats, invoices use usage snapshots with evidence (flat codes only, never names). Differences show in the usage tab and are corrected with adjustment lines, never by editing.
counts.compareBody: Registered, active, occupied, eligible and licensed capacity can all differ. The contract charges for the highlighted one only.
counts.duesNote: An association can exempt its own office flat from dues; it still counts for the platform fee unless the contract excludes it.
counts.fromSites: From the sites step: {{sites}} sites, {{buildings}} buildings.

terms.title: Tax and discounts
terms.intro: Tax is configured per jurisdiction. Discounts need a reason and may need approval.
terms.taxHint: Illustrative codes only. Real codes and rates come from the owner's tax adviser (D-10).
terms.minimumHint: Optional. Recurring charges are topped up to this amount.
terms.capHint: Optional. Recurring charges are reduced to this amount.
terms.approvalHint_one: This contract needs commercial approval ({{count}} rule). You can still continue.
terms.approvalHint_other: This contract needs commercial approval ({{count}} rules). You can still continue.

errors.value: Discount {{n}}: enter a value above zero.
errors.percent: Discount {{n}}: a percentage cannot be more than 100.

quote.title: Quote
quote.intro: Every line explained: basis, quantity, price, proration, discount and tax.
quote.preview: This is a preview for the customer, not an invoice.

review.title: Review and activate
review.intro: Check everything once more. Edit any section and you return here afterwards.
review.simulationBody: The tenant appears in HQ with its licence and contract. No database is provisioned, no email is sent and no invoice is issued.
review.confirmEffect: {{name}} will appear as active (or on trial) with this contract. Simulation only.
review.confirmApprovalEffect: {{name}} will wait for an approver who is not you. Nothing starts until then.

done.title: {{name}} is set up
done.body_active: The tenant is active with its modules and contract (simulation).
done.body_trial: The tenant is on a 30-day trial; charges start when it ends (simulation).
done.pendingBody: A commercial approver will review the contract. You will find it under Awaiting approval.
done.simulated: Simulation: no tenant database, email or invoice was created.

tenants.description: Every tenant's licence, contract and status. Metadata only, never tenant records.
tenants.emptyBody: Change the search or the filters.
tenants.metadataOnly: HQ shows licences and counts only (as of {{date}}). Tenant records need an audited support grant.

requests.intro: Organisations that asked for a workspace, a trial or a conversation with sales. Start setup to create the tenant from a request.

summary.metadataOnly: Licensing and commercial data only. Tenant people, flats and payments are never shown here.

simulator.componentsHint: Edit prices, add components or schedule a price change.
simulator.delta: Against the starting point: {{month}} a month, {{year}} in the first year
simulator.chartSummary: First invoice {{first}}, then {{regular}} in a typical month; {{year}} in the first year.

more.description: Your areas, settings and demo controls.
more.switchRoleHint: The same HQ through another platform role.

tour.name: Platform HQ essentials
tour.summary: What needs attention, the figures, creating tenants, navigation, search and quick actions.

welcome.title: Welcome to Platform HQ
welcome.body: This is where the platform team runs the SaaS: tenants, modules, pricing and approvals. Each tenant's own records stay private to that tenant.

attention.title: Start with what needs you
attention.body: Approvals, trials ending, overdue tenants and new requests. Each item opens the right place.

figures.title: The platform at a glance
figures.body: Monthly recurring revenue, paying tenants, trials, approvals and flats under management. Each card opens the list behind it.

create.title: Create a tenant
create.body: Set up a developer, society, portfolio or custom tenant: modules, sites, pricing, quote and activation.

navigation.title: Find your way
navigation.body: Dashboard, tenants and the pricing simulator. Only areas that work appear here.
navigation.bodyMobile: The bottom bar holds the main areas; More has settings and the demo controls.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: Press Ctrl+K to find tenants, requests and HQ screens.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: Create a tenant, try prices in the simulator, and review approvals and requests.
